note: What each canon ability does, shown on the card instead of the player's description when it's claimed. Keyed by universe, then claim name (case and punctuation ignored). Claims without a blurb keep the description box.

my-hero-academia.All For One: Steals other people's Quirks, stores them, uses several at once, and can give them to others.
my-hero-academia.One For All: A stockpile of power passed from user to user, growing with each one. Grants immense strength and speed, and carries the Quirks of past users.
my-hero-academia.Warp Gate: Creates portals of dark mist that link two places, moving people or attacks through them.
my-hero-academia.Electrification: Covers the body in electricity and discharges it. Going past the user's wattage limit short-circuits their brain and leaves them dazed.
my-hero-academia.Half Hot Half Cold: Makes ice from the right side of the body and fire from the left. Using one side too long builds frostbite or overheating, which the other side balances out.
my-hero-academia.Half-Cold Half-Hot: Makes ice from the right side of the body and fire from the left. Using one side too long builds frostbite or overheating, which the other side balances out.
my-hero-academia.Chronostasis: Clock-hand hair that, when it pricks someone, slows their movement to a near standstill for a time.
my-hero-academia.Cloud: Creates clouds that can be shaped, stood on and ridden.
my-hero-academia.Blood Curdle: Tasting someone's blood paralyzes them for a time that depends on their blood type.
my-hero-academia.Whirlwind: Creates and controls powerful winds, strong enough to carry people and objects.
my-hero-academia.New Order: Touch something and declare a rule for it, and it follows that rule. Only a limited number of rules can be active at once, and using it on yourself or others has a cost.
my-hero-academia.Explosion: Secretes nitroglycerin-like sweat from the palms and sets it off at will. The more the user sweats, the bigger the blasts.
my-hero-academia.Copy: Copies the Quirk of anyone touched and can use it for a few minutes. Can't copy what the Quirk has stored up.
my-hero-academia.Hellflame: Creates and controls intensely hot flames. Overuse builds up heat in the user's body.
my-hero-academia.Overhaul: Touching something takes it apart and can rebuild it however the user likes, from people to the ground around them.
my-hero-academia.Decay: Anything touched with all five fingers crumbles to dust, and the decay spreads through whatever it's connected to.
my-hero-academia.Cremation: Blue flames hotter than ordinary fire. The user's body isn't built for them, so they burn the user too.
my-hero-academia.Stress: Stress the user feels is stored and turned into physical power and size, marked by spreading black lines on the body.
my-hero-academia.Erasure: Cancels the Quirk of anyone the user looks at, for as long as their eyes stay open. Doesn't work on Heteromorphic (Mutation) Quirks.
my-hero-academia.Creation: Creates any non-living object from the lipids in the body, as long as the user knows its molecular structure.
my-hero-academia.Hardening: Hardens the skin into a sharp, rock-like armor that blocks attacks and makes every strike a weapon.
my-hero-academia.Engine: Engines in the calves give bursts of incredible running speed.
my-hero-academia.Zero Gravity: Touching something with all five fingertips cancels its gravity; too much makes the user nauseous.
my-hero-academia.Frog: Does anything a frog can: a long tongue, wall-climbing, leaping, camouflage and toxic mucus.
my-hero-academia.Dark Shadow: A sentient shadow creature that fights alongside the user, stronger and wilder in the dark.
my-hero-academia.Invisibility: The user's body is permanently invisible and can bend light around it.
my-hero-academia.Acid: Secretes acid from the skin, from corrosive to slippery, and can control how strong it is.
my-hero-academia.Tape: Shoots and reels in strong tape from the elbows.
my-hero-academia.Earphone Jack: Earlobe jacks that send the user's heartbeat as shockwaves and pick up faint sounds.
my-hero-academia.Navel Laser: Fires a sparkling laser from the navel; overuse upsets the stomach.
my-hero-academia.Pop Off: Pulls sticky spheres off the scalp that stick to anything but the user.
my-hero-academia.Tail: A large, strong tail for martial arts, balance and climbing.
my-hero-academia.Anivoice: Talks to animals and can ask them for help.
my-hero-academia.Dupli-Arms: Tentacles on the arms that can grow copies of any body part.
my-hero-academia.Sugar Rush: Eating sugar multiplies the user's strength for a few minutes, then dulls the mind.
my-hero-academia.Steel: Turns the body to steel, getting stronger the more iron the user has eaten.
my-hero-academia.Vines: Thorny vines for hair that the user controls and can regrow by drinking water and sunbathing.
my-hero-academia.Big Fist: Enlarges the hands to giant size for powerful strikes and grabs.
my-hero-academia.Gigantification: Grows the whole body to giant size, but only to one fixed size.
my-hero-academia.Brainwashing: Anyone who answers the user is put under mind control until struck hard enough to snap out of it.
my-hero-academia.Fat Absorption: Sinks attacks into the user's body fat, then burns the fat for a huge burst of strength.
my-hero-academia.Voice: A voice loud enough to deafen and knock back anything in front of the user.
my-hero-academia.Lizard: Anything a lizard can do: wall-climbing, a tail and regenerating lost body parts.
my-hero-academia.Magnetism: Magnetizes people near the user, pulling or pushing them depending on their sex.
my-hero-academia.Compress: Compresses anything the user touches into a small marble, and releases it with a snap.
my-hero-academia.Muscle Augmentation: Grows extra muscle fibers that greatly increase strength, speed and defense.
my-hero-academia.Permeation: Lets the user pass through anything, phasing in and out of solid matter.
my-hero-academia.Fierce Wings: Large wings of feathers the user can control one by one: flight, blades and rescues at once.
my-hero-academia.Foresight: After touching someone and meeting their eyes, the user can see their future for an hour.
my-hero-academia.Transform: Drinking someone's blood lets the user turn into a perfect copy of them.
my-hero-academia.Double: Makes copies of anything the user has measured, people included.
my-hero-academia.Rewind: Rewinds a living thing's body to an earlier state, healing it or undoing it completely.
